home.title: AI image and video upscaling, in your browser
home.subtitle: Increase the resolution of photos and video with AI. Nothing is uploaded — every file is processed on your own device.
home.f1.title: Images and video
home.f1.text: PNG, JPG and WebP images, MP4 and MOV video. Each pass through the AI model doubles both dimensions.
home.f2.title: Multi-pass and target size
home.f2.text: Choose how many passes to run, or name the resolution you want and let the app work out the passes.
home.f3.title: Batch and folders
home.f3.text: Queue several files or a whole folder, set defaults once, and override individual files where needed.
home.f4.title: PDF export
home.f4.text: Turn a batch of processed images into a PDF, in natural filename order and without distortion.
home.f5.title: Local processing
home.f5.text: Upscaling runs on your GPU through WebGPU. Files never leave the browser and nothing is sent to a server.
home.f6.title: Image editor
home.f6.text: Crop, curves, colour, filters, blur and retouch — the same local-only approach, in English and Ukrainian.
home.requirements: Requires a desktop version of Chrome or Edge with WebGPU support.
